module.name: RTT Moderation Bot
module.summary: Governance substrate engine: regime shifts, continuity of norms, collapse signatures, projection-loss, and triadic identity across moderation events.

module.name: RTT-Moderation
module.summary: Triadic interpretation of governance, rule enforcement, and community substrate stability.
module.purpose: Provide triadic identity for moderation sequences: rule applications, incident responses, norm drift, collapse signatures, and continuity of governance.
module.audience: Governance designers, community managers, diagnostics systems

input_spec.notes: Moderation bot interprets governance identity; it does not enforce rules.

steps: Lumen: extract structural signals (rule type, severity, substrate anchors)
Hephaestus: classify regime per event (local enforcement, structural governance, continuity of norms)
Aurion: detect collapse signatures, projection-loss, lineage breaks in governance
Harmonia: compute triadic identity for the entire moderation sequence
StateEmitter: emit JSON conforming to module_moderation_schema.json

examples.description: A moderation sequence showing norm drift, regime shifts, and a governance collapse signature.

context.drift: Moderation drift is governance: norms evolve across events.
context.coherence: Moderation bot is the RTT engine for governance identity.
